changes.investigation: first-party EV Driver web portal tariff surface

positiveEvidence.source: Hera Ricarica EV Driver Web Portal /tariffs
positiveEvidence.finding: A first-party Tariffe page exists and separates Offerta flat, Offerta a consumo and Penalita. The page confirms direct Hera tariff handling rather than requiring an eMSP surface.

positiveEvidence.source: Hera Ricarica EV Driver Web Portal /tariffs
positiveEvidence.finding: The direct post-charge occupation penalty is explicit: after 60 minutes from completion, 0.08 EUR/min for Type 2 / Type 3A from 07:00-23:00 every day, and 0.15 EUR/min for CHAdeMO / Combo CCS2 from 00:00-23:59 every day.

positiveEvidence.source: Hera Ricarica EV Driver Web Portal root
positiveEvidence.finding: The first-party map exposes power buckets 0-22 kW, 23-50 kW, 51-100 kW, 101-150 kW and >150 kW, plus plug and availability filters. This is a viable exact station discovery surface.

The current portal stack exposes Angular 14-era front-end components and Tomcat-era server dependencies, confirming a client/server web application suitable for future static bundle or network endpoint inspection.

negativeOrExcludedEvidence.finding: The indexed page currently exposes the penalty values but not the numeric energy prices for Offerta a consumo / flat in retrievable text; no deterministic EVSE->energy-price mapping can yet be promoted.

negativeOrExcludedEvidence.source: fresh indexed site searches for /api/, connector/tariff JSON and runtime/main bundles
negativeOrExcludedEvidence.finding: No public indexed API path, station tariff JSON endpoint, or bundle filename carrying tariff data surfaced in this run.
